    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Paddock → French 'patte d'oie' (goose foot) via sound 'pad-ok' → 'patte' + 'oc' (Occitan yes)",

    "languages": ["fr", "oc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Paddock → 'pad dock' → 'dap' (to spring) + 'ock' (suffix of smallness)",

    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },

    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",

    "reading": "Mouth, ox, door, door, eye, palm, palm — speaking through the gate of the seeing hand.",
    "languages": ["he", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "P=80, A=1, D=4, D=4, O=15, C=3, K=11 → sum 118; 1+1+8=10 → 1 (unity)",
    "reading": "The number 118 reduces to 1 — the return to the single source, the one behind many.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5

    "languages": ["en", "fr", "la"],

    "confidence": 0.8
  }
